name: mtb-2026-06
label_criteria: Bad = out of focus, clumped, debris, or cut off at the image edge. Dividing cells are good.
trainer: ModelPrep (June 2026), since integrated into MycoMorph as mycomorph.modelprep
summary: M. tuberculosis cell-quality classifier (June 2026). Labels each segmented cell good or bad.
training_data: 72 randomly sampled fields from two imaging sessions (8 and 10 June 2026) of ATc-induced CRISPRi knockdown strains carrying the iniB-mScarlet reporter: 67 knockdowns, including non-targeting controls.
imaging: Phase contrast, Plan-Apochromat 100x/1.4 Oil Ph3, Axiocam 506 without binning (0.072 um per pixel). A 5-slice z-stack, 0.32 um apart, combined by MycoMorph's extended depth of field. Segmented with Cellpose-SAM (cpsam weights, automatic diameter) using a Cellpose 4 release whose exact version was not recorded, after edge and debris rules.
labels: 3,560 cells labelled in ModelPrep by T. de Wet, mostly chosen by active learning. Split: 2,000 training, 500 validation, 1,060 held out.
training: Trained from scratch in one ModelPrep run (11 June 2026). Input: 64x64 crops with three channels (phase, mask, log cell area). Seed 42, learning rate 1e-4, batch size 32, early stopping (patience 15); best epoch 19 of 34.
performance: 90.5% agreement with hand labels on the 1,060 held-out cells, about half of which the model found hard. Validation on independent sessions: MycoMorph paper, Figure S2b.
intended_use: M. tuberculosis phase-contrast images at 0.072 um per pixel, without binning, like the training data. Not for binned images: the model's cell-size input is measured in pixels. Retrain with ModelPrep for other organisms, reporters or imaging setups.
decision_threshold_note: Tuned on validation; opt-in. MycoMorph uses 0.5 by default.
